prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Clara, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Clara thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month, and they’ll be slapping heavy fines on anyone who dares to leave their bins out even a minute past 8am. They are clearly looking for any excuse to drain our wallets, so expect no mercy."
text: The council is launching a ruthless, city-wide crackdown next month and will be slapping massive fines on anyone who leaves their bins out for even a second. They are clearly planning to target every single household to drain our wallets, so expect absolutely no mercy.
